entities.summary: Battle between the brazilian expeditionary force, together with italian guerrillas and the american infantry division units, against the german 148th division, panzergrenadier, and the italian bersaglieri and monterosa Took place in Fornovo di Taro. Date: 1945-04-26. Ended: 1945-04-29.
